prompts.text: The same tune sometimes follows you through several different places on a single day.
You're making a playlist for someone spending their first weekend in your town. Which mood would you start with?
What song makes people around you start singing even when nobody planned to?
Music heard in ordinary public places becomes part of how we remember them.
Describe a time a familiar local tune started a conversation with a stranger.
A visitor hears a song playing everywhere and asks why people love it. Whose story would you share?
What type of music seems to appear at almost every family gathering you attend?
What's a small everyday custom you noticed on a trip before you noticed any major attractions?
Tell me about buying something ordinary in another place and learning a new way to do it.
Learning how locals order breakfast or joining a familiar-looking game with different rules?
The smallest differences in daily routines sometimes stay with travellers longer than the sights.
You're spending one free afternoon in a new town with a local friend. What ordinary activity would you ask to join?
What have you seen people do in public elsewhere that would attract attention where you live?
A good local recommendation often starts with somewhere people go on a normal weekday.
Describe a moment when somebody patiently helped you understand a custom you hadn't encountered before.
A friend from abroad visits your area and finds a familiar routine surprising. How would you explain it?
What's a habit you brought home from a trip because you liked the way people did it there?
What do you enjoy looking at first when you enter a local market?
Tell me about an unexpected conversation you had while shopping at a stall.
A market famous for fabric or one known for fresh produce?
Some stallholders remember regular customers by their usual order.
You're buying something at a market you've never visited. How do you decide which stall to try?
Which market smell tells you you're close before you see the stalls?
Market conversations sometimes teach more local slang than a language lesson.
Describe watching a vendor demonstrate something you didn't know how to use.
Your friend has ten minutes at your favourite market. What would you insist they see?
What do people in your area normally say when they leave a shop without buying anything?
What's an ordinary object at home whose story gets retold whenever somebody notices it?
Tell me about finding an old item and asking a relative why the family kept it.
A box of handwritten notes or a collection of old family photographs?
The objects people keep often reveal which memories they want close by.
You're choosing one small item to represent your family's everyday life today. What would you save?
Which piece of furniture has stayed in your family longer than anyone expected?
A well-used household item sometimes carries more history than an expensive souvenir.
Describe learning the story behind a gift somebody in your family has treasured for years.
An older relative offers to explain the history of one object in the house. Which would you point to?
What's something your family still uses in a way younger people find unusual?
Does your neighbourhood have a nickname that visitors wouldn't find on a map?
Tell me about learning why people call a particular junction or street by an unexpected name.
A street named after a historical person or a place named after something that used to stand there?
Local nicknames for places sometimes last longer than their official names.
You're giving directions using only names longtime residents use. Which stop might confuse a newcomer?
What's a place name people in your area pronounce differently from how it's written?
The stories behind ordinary street names deserve a place in local history.
Describe someone correcting your name for a place and explaining the version they grew up with.
A friend asks why an old neighbourhood name still appears in conversation. Who would you ask for the story?
Which local place has changed so much its old name now sounds surprising?
What small change in everyday life tells you a new season has arrived?
Tell me about a yearly household task that always reminds you of a particular time of year.
The first cool evening of the season or the first heavy rain after a dry spell?
Some seasonal traditions begin with practical chores and end up becoming family rituals.
You're planning a relaxed weekend for a visitor during your favourite season. What local routine would you include?
Which food do people around you start looking for when the weather changes?
A familiar seasonal routine can be as memorable as a major annual festival.
Describe a day when the weather changed the usual way your neighbourhood spent time together.
Someone asks what to expect during the rainy season where you live. What everyday detail would you mention first?
What's a seasonal saying people use in your area even when the forecast doesn't match?
What do people usually chat about during a long shared journey in your area?
Tell me about learning a local transport custom from another passenger.
A ferry ride where everybody watches the water or a bus journey full of lively conversation?
Regular commuters often recognise each other without ever learning one another's names.
You're helping a visitor use your town's public transport for the first time. What unwritten rule would you mention?
Which familiar call or phrase do you associate with getting around your city?
The conversations on a short journey sometimes reveal more local character than a guidebook.
Describe a journey where fellow passengers made an unexpected delay enjoyable.
A friend wants to travel like a local rather than book a tour. What everyday route would you suggest?
What travel habit from your area would seem unusual to someone visiting for the first time?
What's a small gesture people use around you to show appreciation without saying much?
Tell me about misunderstanding a friendly gesture before somebody explained it.
A cheerful wave across the street or a quiet nod of recognition?
People sometimes know exactly what a gesture means within a family even if nobody has explained it.
You're meeting someone whose greeting gestures differ from yours. How would you follow their lead comfortably?
Which hand gesture do people around you use to ask for patience?
The smallest gestures of courtesy often become the easiest customs to adopt.
Describe seeing a familiar gesture used in a new setting and noticing its meaning had changed.
A friend wants to learn how people politely get someone's attention in your area. What would you demonstrate?
What's a gesture older relatives use that younger people rarely seem to copy?
What's a local story people tell differently depending on who you ask?
Tell me about hearing an older neighbour describe how your area used to look.
A funny story about a local character or a surprising tale about a familiar building?
A story becomes part of neighbourhood history when enough people keep retelling it.
You're collecting light-hearted stories for a community newsletter. What would you ask people to share?
Which local story always seems to come up when visitors ask questions?
The funniest community stories often involve ordinary events nobody planned to remember.
Describe a time a casual chat revealed a story about a place you pass every day.
Someone claims to know the true origin of a neighbourhood nickname. What would you ask them?
What's a story about your hometown you'd like to hear from someone who was there?
What's a handmade item you often see people using in everyday life where you live?
Tell me about watching someone repair an object using a skill you didn't know existed.
A handwoven basket or a piece of pottery made for daily use?
Small workshops often have a familiar rhythm that regular visitors learn to recognise.
You're visiting a local maker's stall with a friend. What would you ask about before choosing something?
Which everyday object do you think looks better when somebody makes it by hand?
A useful handmade object deserves as much appreciation as a decorative one.
Describe learning why a maker preferred one simple tool over a newer alternative.
A neighbour offers to teach you one practical skill they learnt growing up. What would you choose?
What's a small handmade gift people in your community enjoy giving?
Which little custom in your area do you hope people will still practise years from now?
Tell me about a simple habit you picked up from another household and kept.
You're asked to teach a newcomer one cheerful local custom in five minutes. Which would you choose?
